posts.caption:
Most traders don't need another strategy. They need rules they actually follow.

That's why we built Zenlot: a free forex trading journal that helps you plan, record and review every trade against your own rules.

On this page, every week:
• Risk maths with real numbers (position sizing, drawdowns, R:R)
• Trader psychology and the habits behind blown accounts
• Checklists and review routines you can copy

Follow along, and tell us in the comments: what's the one trading rule you find hardest to stick to?

Zenlot is free on iOS and Android.

Educational content, not financial advice.
